definition: E2E coverage = fraction of accepted critical user journeys that have an automated, deterministic E2E spec. This is journey coverage, not V8 line coverage.

flows.title: Desktop onboarding: launch app, add/select a local project, persist project shell state
flows.rationale: Launches the real Electron app with onboardingVersion=0, walks the OnboardingWizard, and asserts settings:set persists the bumped onboarding version.

flows.title: Desktop project board: load issues, filter/group/search/sort, open issue detail
flows.rationale: Seeds cached issues, renders the KanbanBoard, exercises search/filter, and opens issue detail via the store.

flows.title: Issue creation/PRD flow: create or edit an issue draft, attach PRD context, validate required fields
flows.rationale: Opens CreateIssueModal, asserts empty-body validation blocks submit, then a valid body enables create against the fake gh.

flows.title: Pipeline lifecycle: plan/review/execute/verify state transitions using deterministic mocked providers
flows.rationale: Drives plan→review→execute→verify by firing synthetic pipeline:phase IPC events and asserts the issue-detail header reflects each phase.

flows.title: Manual approval/resume flow: approval gate, resume action, retry routing for structured verification failures
flows.rationale: Places a thread in the awaiting-approval phase and asserts the ApprovalSection approve action invokes pipeline:approve.

flows.title: Terminal drawer/transcript: open terminal output, render tool events, copy/open targets, handle long transcript windowing
flows.rationale: Opens the terminal drawer and fires terminal:event push events, asserting the transcript renders the streamed tool/text events.

flows.title: Project settings: update model/provider/pipeline/runtime QA settings and verify persistence
flows.rationale: Opens ProjectSettingsModal, changes a setting, saves, and asserts the corresponding project:set-* IPC fires and persists.

flows.title: Pull request panel: list PRs, open details, surface checks/status/actions with mocked GitHub data
flows.rationale: Stubs github:list-prs / github:get-pr-detail via the renderer bridge and asserts list render, filtering, and detail open.

flows.title: Notifications/inbox: render actionable notifications and route to the right issue/project target
flows.rationale: Fires a notification:fire push event, asserts the inbox row appears and routing to the issue/project target works.

flows.title: Web/docs smoke: production web build serves landing page and docs routes without broken critical content
flows.rationale: Builds the static web + docs exports, serves them, and asserts the landing page and key docs routes return 200 with expected content.
